assessment: This important study presents a comprehensive investigation into cell-free DNA (cfDNA) within the context of 3D cell cultures, offering valuable insights into this emerging research area. Despite being an exploratory study, the findings provide compelling evidence that continued progress holds the potential for the establishment of versatile 3D cell culture cfDNA assays. Such assays could serve as invaluable research and clinical tools, enabling monitoring of organoid growth and development, enhanced characterization of tissue dynamics, and ultimately facilitating the identification of novel biomarkers.
